content.text:
ISSUE_KIND: pothole
ISSUE: Water-filled pothole in the roadway pavement
DETAILS: The photo shows a deep, water-filled pothole surrounded by cracked and deteriorating asphalt pavement. There is no user note.
ORGANIZATION: Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration (MDOT SHA)
DEPARTMENT: District 3 Office (Laurel Maintenance Shop)
WHY: Although this spot is inside the incorporated City of College Park, Baltimore Avenue is U.S. Route 1 (US 1), a U.S. numbered highway maintained by the Maryland Department of Transportation State Highway Administration. The City of College Park explicitly lists Baltimore Avenue / Route 1 as a non-City street maintained by the State Highway Administration and directs residents to report potholes on it to SHA (specifically the District 3 Laurel Shop covering northern Prince George's County).
COVERAGE_QUOTE: "MDOT SHA maintains more than 2,500 bridges and 17,000 miles of non-toll state roads – the interstate, US and state numbered routes in Maryland's 23 counties."
